Our office attended the 5th-anniversary celebration for Lowcountry Tutoring.

For five years, they’ve been serving the Bluffton community, dedicated to helping every student reach their full potential.

South Carolina STRONG.

We've voted to fund DHS 11 times. Enough is enough. 

Senator Thune has become a thorn in the side of the Republican Party and it's become a national problem.

Video

Tonight, my prayers are with our brave men and women serving in the Middle East. 

Bring them home safe. 🙏🇺🇸

MACE WIN: We helped to secure a $625,000 federal grant for the Summerville Police Department.

This funding will be used to hire more officers and expand their department as Summerville continues to rapidly grow. The Summerville Police Department has met every single one of these challenges head on, proving why they are so deserving of this federal investment. Our officers are out there every single day keeping up with every bit of it. They deserve the resources to do their jobs and do them righ

JUST IN: The FDA is ending inhumane testing on beagles, chimpanzees, and other animals.

This is a win for animals, a win for science, and a win for common sense.

For too long, defenseless, voiceless animals have suffered in government labs while “science” was used as an excuse for animal cruelty. This is why we introduced legislation like the PAAW Act to stop the NIH from funding research causing significant pain or distress to dogs and cats. This is also why we secured victories in the NDAA s

One of our constituents, Ben Steen from Furman University, stopped by our D.C. office to interview us for a class project. 

We’d say he deserves an A.
Serve the American people like you're supposed to, pass the SAVE America Act, fund DHS, and do your jobs.

Chuck Schumer preaching about the sacredness of elections while blocking the SAVE America Act. 

We’d call it laughable, but it’s honestly just concerning how delusional the Left has become.
To every survivor of Jeffrey Epstein: we have not forgotten about you. And we will NEVER forget about you.

Fund ALL of DHS. No excuses.

Senator Thune needs to reconvene the Senate and pass what the House sent on Friday.

We met with Lowcountry Veterans Home Executive Director Courtney Williams.

They provide transitional housing for homeless veterans in the Charleston area, working with organizations like Ralph Johnson VA, One80 Place, and Charleston Vets to get veterans back on their feet. Our office is backing their federal grant proposals and working to get them every resource available.

No veteran who served this country should be sleeping on the streets.

South Carolina STRONG.

Our Modernizing Government Technology Reform Act brings Washington's outdated IT systems into the 21st century. For too long, the federal government has relied on obsolete technology wasting taxpayer dollars and creating security risks. This bill brings real accountability, exposes outdated systems, and ensures agencies modernize their technology.

Video

Our office helped secure more than $381 MILLION in federal infrastructure grants for South Carolina.

As the fastest-growing state in the country in 2025, South Carolina’s roads, bridges, and transit systems need to keep pace with this growth. These investments ensure they do.

We helped secure:
✅ $195,000,000 – I-526 Long Point Interchange
✅ $120,000,000 – Hilton Head Island Bridge Project
✅ $25,900,000 – Lowcountry Rapid Transit Project
✅ $24,000,000 – Dorchester County BUILD Grant
✅ $6,602,40

A group of pastors from across South Carolina stopped by our D.C. office to give us a copy of a William Tyndale Bible and pray over us. 

They told us the Tyndale Bible is celebrating its 500th anniversary this year. 500 years later, the message still stands: faith and freedom matter. 

God Bless.

History will not forgive those who treat war as a political prop.

I represent a military district. Members of my family serve. Our sons and daughters are the ones who answer the call on orders from the Commander in Chief. That is the solemn obligation our military carries every single day.

We should eliminate Iran’s nuclear threat. We should destroy the terrorists. And we should do so with the least possible risk to American lives.

Video

Today we recognize Vietnam War Veterans Day.

These men and women were sent to serve in the Vietnam War and came home without the welcome they earned.

Vietnam veterans embody quiet courage, carrying burdens seen and unseen long after their service ended. They did not serve for recognition. They served because America called.

To dad and every Vietnam veteran, welcome home. We will never forget. Thank you for your service.
If you aren't supporting the SAVE America Act, you are the problem.

What the Epstein survivors deserve: accountability, justice, truth, and transparency. 

What they've received: delays, backlogs, redactions, and cover-ups. 

We will not stop pushing for accountability and exposing the truth until these victims get the answers they deserve.
